mentions.name: Keepsake Box
mentions.description: A personal keepsake web app for couples that presents a timeline of shared relationship memories—first dates, events, trips, moves—installable via Tauri so a partner can view it offline. Planned features include customization and a "Reasons I love you" jar that serves random notes written by one's partner, with the goal of being a living collection of memories and notes that evolves with the relationship. Built with Elixir and Phoenix.
mentions.problem: Long-distance partners lack a dedicated place to collect and revisit shared relationship memories (born from wanting a meaningful birthday/anniversary gift).
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.keepsakebox.app/

I was thinking about what to get my long-distance girlfriend for her birthday which coincidentally was also the anniversary of our first date. So I thought of building her a personal website, installable via tauri so she can view it offline whenever she wants, that has a timeline of all the things we went through: first date, events, trips, moves etc.

Now I want to polish this, make it customizable, add more features like a "Reasons I love you" jar which gives you random notes your partner wrote, and offer it to others as well.
